abstract_sentences.text: Obtaining high-quality outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs) often depends upon the choice of a sampling-based decoding strategy to probabilistically choose the next token at each generation step.

evidence.anchor: Obtaining high-quality outputs from Large Language Models

abstract_sentences.text: While a variety of such sampling methods have been proposed, their performance can be sensitive to the selection of hyperparameters which may require different settings depending upon the generation task and temperature configuration.

evidence.anchor: performance can be sensitive to the selection of hyperparameters

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we introduce p-less sampling: an information-theoretic approach to sampling which dynamically sets a truncation threshold at each decoding step based on the entire token probability distribution.
abstract_sentences.linkage: answers the gap with the method

abstract_sentences.text: Unlike existing methods, p-less sampling has no hyperparameters and consistently produces high-quality outputs as temperature increases.
abstract_sentences.linkage: states the differentiator and strongest scope claim

abstract_sentences.text: We provide theoretical perspectives on p-less sampling to ground our proposed method and conduct experiments to empirically validate its effectiveness across a range of math, logical reasoning, and creative writing tasks.

evidence.anchor: provide theoretical perspectives on p-less sampling

abstract_sentences.text: Our results demonstrate how p-less sampling consistently outperforms existing sampling approaches while exhibiting much less degradation in text quality at higher temperature values.
abstract_sentences.linkage: moves from setup to quality claim

abstract_sentences.text: We further show how p-less achieves greater inference-time efficiency than alternative methods through lower average token sampling times and shorter generation lengths, without sacrificing accuracy.
Finally, we provide analyses to highlight the benefits of p-less through qualitative examples, case studies, and diversity assessments.

evidence.anchor: qualitative examples, case studies, and diversity assessments

abstract_sentences.linkage: ends with an unresolved code pointer

abstract_analysis.reports_experimental_results: Qualitative claims only; no numerical effect, denominator, uncertainty, or failure boundary.
abstract_analysis.theory_and_limits: Theory appears as “perspectives”; no limitation appears. The strongest quality claim is sentence 6, followed by efficiency in sentence 7.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 整条温度调整后的 token probability distribution 通过 collision probability 生成逐步阈值，进而移除采样超参数，并把高温质量、效率和多样性稳定性连成一条证据链。（PDF p.4, §3.1, “sum of squared token probabilities”, explicit；p.7, Table 1, explicit）
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Equations 1-10、Tables 1-4、Figures 1-4、效率复杂度解释和一个高熵案例，足以判断方法与主结果；seed、完整矩阵和失败边界仍需附录。（PDF pp.4-10, §§3-5, layout_observation）
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载证明、完整温度结果、seed、hyperparameter sweep、prompts、human evaluation、profiling 和 failure cases；正文节奏紧凑，可复现性与限制判断依赖附录。（PDF p.11, §7；p.23, §C.3；pp.42-44, §C.13, explicit）
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效模式是“阈值公式 → 可证明边界 → 温度曲线/完整矩阵 → entropy 与 admitted-token 轨迹”，同一机制在定义、预测和诊断层重复出现。（PDF p.4, Eq.2；p.16, Proposition 1；p.30, Table 13, explicit）
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大缺口位于 correctness 解释：Pθ 被代作真实 desirability distribution，论文没有校准实验直接检验这一步；输出质量实验无法单独验证该语义机制。（PDF p.4, §3.1, “best empirical estimate of the true token distribution”, interpretation）
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 先把主方法压成一个可执行量，再为该量给出边界和可观测预测，主结果随后沿预测变量组织，完整矩阵留在附录。（PDF pp.4-7, §§3.1-4.2, interpretation）
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于中间量可在推理时直接观测、并能跨任务定义共同预测轴的工作；核心机制涉及不可观测标签或强交互干预时，单一诊断量无法替代识别设计。（PDF p.4, §3.1, interpretation）
